title: 2 Br / 2 Ba-Downtown | Pool | Walkable to Broadway
description:
Great location! 2 Blocks from local Restaurants, Breweries, and shops. 

1 mile from Broadway and the Nissan Stadium. 

High speed Internet, Smart TVs, Pool, Fitness Room, covered parking, shared laundry facilities onsite.

Restaurants 2 blocks from the condo:
Retrograde Coffee
Social Cantina
Tailgate Brewery
Third and Home
Kyuramen
Jonathan's Grille
Von Elrod's
Neighbors
Desano Pizzeria

The space
Smart lock with personalized code.

Amazon Fire TVs in each room. (55", 50", 43")

1 King Bed with Walk-in Closet (BR1)
1 Full Bed Walk-in Closet (BR2)
1 Twin Bunk (BR2)
1 Queen Sleeper Sofa in Living Room
1 Queen Air Mattress (available if needed) 
2 Full Bathrooms
Full Kitchen
Balcony to overlook the river

Guest access
We have complimentary covered parking right next to the condo with a 24 hour security guard on site. 

From the condo, you have a view of the beautiful Nashville Cumberland river. 

Staying at this condo gives you access to a pool, workout facility and washer/dryer. It’s a very safe building. All of the tenants have agreed on a No Party Policy with a strictly enforced noise ordinance so you won’t have noisy neighbors.

- Germantown (Popular Neighborhood)
- Broadway (Main Strip of Bars) (1 Mile) 
- Retrograde Coffee (2 Blocks)
- Nissan Stadium (1 Mile)
- Ryman Auditorium (1 Mile)
- Bridgestone Arena (Predators Arena) (1 mile)
- Riverfront Park Greenway (Runs by complex)
- Brooklyn Bowling (Bowling Alley, Restaurant, Music Venue) (2 Blocks)
- Country Music Hall of Fame (1.2 Mile)
- Nashville Sounds’ First Tennessee Field (2 blocks)
- Printer’s Alley (0.8 mile)
- Mother's Ruin (1 Mile)
- Sonny's Patio Pub (1 Mile
-Tailgate Brewery (2 blocks)
- Bearded Iris Brewery (1 mile)
- Jonathan's Grille (2 Blocks) 
- Third and Home Rooftop (2 blocks)
- Neighbors Bar & Grill (2 Blocks)
- Von Elrod's Beer Garden (2 Blocks)

Other things to note
The walk to Broadway 1 mile. The most conventional way is to Lyft/Uber. Riverfront park runs right by the condo. Many locals and guest use the pathway to exercise and enjoy the Nashville Riverfront Park.

I think the most scenic walk is up Stockyard to 3rd Ave, from there a left will take you to Broadway and a right will take you further into Germantown.
